title: Josiah knows Max went into the woods to pray

tellings.quote: one is Josiah says you know Max went into the woods and was praying last night

plain: A documentary filmmaker, Ky Dickens, tells of Josiah, a nonspeaking young man in her film about telepathy. She says Josiah told her that a man named Max Davis had gone into the woods and prayed the night before. If true, it would mean Josiah could sense what someone did when no one was there to tell him.
